died.name: Şehzade Ahmed Nuri
died.cause: note found in his pocket after he starved to death in a French public park
died.last_words: If I die, do not blame anyone because I am starving. I was making a living by playing piano in a movie theater. Now I can not find this job either. You bury me as a Muslim.

born.name: James Maitland Hog
born.cause: spelling out his final words on a printed alphabet with a reed in his mouth
born.last_words: I am looking to the Savior. My only hope is in Jesus.

born.name: Mata Hari
born.cause: prior to execution by French firing squad for spying for Germany during World War I
